title: todo.txt
subtitle: {shown} shown · {open} open
empty_hint: Clear a filter or press N to add a task.
help_body: J/K or arrow keys select. N adds. Ctrl+F searches. X completes. E edits. Y copies. D deletes. Shift+arrow keys move.

todo_file.label: todo.txt file
todo_file.description: The todo.txt file to read and write. An empty value uses the plugin data directory.

add_creation_date.label: Add creation dates
add_creation_date.description: Prefix newly added tasks with today's date when they do not already contain one.

default_sort.label: Default sort
default_sort.description: The ordering used whenever the panel opens.

glyph.label: Bar glyph
glyph.description: The icon shown in the bar.

display.label: Bar content
display.description: Show only the icon, the open count, or the next task on horizontal bars.

max_title_length.label: Maximum title length
max_title_length.description: Maximum characters used for the next task in a horizontal bar.

show_due.label: Show due date
show_due.description: Show the next task's due date in a horizontal bar.

hide_when_empty.label: Hide when empty
hide_when_empty.description: Hide the widget when no open tasks remain.

remote_origin: The calendar points to a different server.
remote_conflict: A task changed in another client. Reload and try again.
remote_principal: The server returned no CalDAV principal.
remote_home: The server returned no calendar home.
remote_password: Save the account password in Noctalia Calendar settings.
remote_choose_account: Choose a CalDAV account in plugin settings.
remote_account_missing: Add a CalDAV account in Noctalia Calendar settings.
remote_client_certificate: Noctalia’s plugin HTTP API cannot use client certificates.
remote_password_file: The calendar password file is unavailable or invalid.
